devdoc.details: Wallet addresses and all stored data are public. Do not submit personal details or secrets.      Metadata and reason hashes should be keccak256 hashes of the exact off-chain content;      a hash can check matching content but does not prove that the content is true.

approveClaim(uint256,uint32,bytes32).details: The organization may approve fewer or more minutes than claimed; both values remain recorded.

params.approvedMinutes: Approved duration in whole minutes (60 minutes = 1 hour).
params.reviewNoteHash: Optional hash of off-chain review notes.

closeActivity(uint256).details: Pending claims remain reviewable by the active issuing organization.

correctRecord(uint256,uint32,uint64,byte.details: The replacement keeps the same volunteer, issuer, activity, and claim; only the      approved minutes or service date may change. Use revokeRecord for other errors.

params.correctedMinutes: Corrected duration in whole minutes; must be positive.
params.correctedServiceDate: Corrected Unix timestamp in seconds, within the activity's date window.
params.reasonHash: Required keccak256 hash of the off-chain correction explanation.

returns.replacementRecordId: New record ID linked to the corrected original.

createActivity(string,bytes32,string,uin.details: The metadata URI and date window cannot be edited; close this activity and create      another one if its published details need to change.

params.metadataHash: keccak256 hash of the exact activity metadata bytes fetched from metadataURI.
params.serviceEndDate: Inclusive end of the service window, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.
params.serviceStartDate: Inclusive start of the service window, as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

params.activityId: Activity whose claims should be returned.

returns.claimIds: Claim IDs, including pending, approved, and rejected claims.

params.issuer: Organization wallet whose records should be returned.

returns.serviceRecordIds: Record IDs issued by the organization.

params.issuer: Organization wallet whose activities should be returned.

returns.activityIds: Activity IDs, including open and closed activities.

returns.serviceRecord: The public record and its current validity/correction links.

getVolunteerHistory(address).details: The lookup is public because blockchain state and activity are publicly observable.

params.volunteer: Wallet whose history should be returned.

returns.claimIds: Claim IDs, including pending and rejected claims.
returns.serviceRecordIds: Issued record IDs, including revoked and replaced records.

params.metadataHash: keccak256 hash of the exact metadata bytes fetched from metadataURI.
params.wallet: Organization wallet that will create activities and review claims.

params.reasonHash: Required keccak256 hash of the off-chain rejection reason; keep personal details off-chain.
Required keccak256 hash of the off-chain revocation reason.

setOrganizationActive(address,bool).details: Deactivation blocks new activity, claim, review, revocation, and correction actions;      it does not change the status of records already issued.

params.active: Whether the organization should be allowed to perform new actions.

submitServiceClaim(uint256,uint32,uint64.details: Multiple claims per activity are allowed; the application should avoid accidental duplicates.

params.claimedMinutes: Claimed duration in whole minutes (60 minutes = 1 hour).
params.serviceDate: Service date as a Unix timestamp in seconds; use UTC midnight for date-only input.
params.supportingInfoHash: Optional keccak256 hash of off-chain supporting information; do not store personal data here.

approveClaim(uint256,uint32,bytes32).notice: Approves a pending claim and creates its service record in the same transaction.

closeActivity(uint256).notice: Closes an activity so volunteers cannot submit new claims for it.

constructor.notice: Sets the deploying wallet as the platform administrator.

correctRecord(uint256,uint32,uint64,byte.notice: Corrects an immutable record by invalidating it and issuing a linked replacement.

createActivity(string,bytes32,string,uin.notice: Creates an activity with immutable public details and a service-date window.

getActivityClaimIds(uint256).notice: Returns all claim IDs submitted against an activity.

getClaim(uint256).notice: Returns a claim and its review outcome.

getIssuerRecordIds(address).notice: Returns all issued record IDs for an organization, including replaced records.

getOrganizationActivityIds(address).notice: Returns all activity IDs created by an organization wallet.

getOrganizationById(uint256).notice: Returns organization details by sequential organization identifier.

getServiceRecord(uint256).notice: Returns a service record for volunteer history or public verification.

getVolunteerHistory(address).notice: Returns all claim and service-record IDs indexed for a volunteer wallet.

rejectClaim(uint256,bytes32).notice: Rejects a pending claim without creating a service record.

revokeRecord(uint256,bytes32).notice: Revokes a currently valid service record without deleting its history.

setOrganizationActive(address,bool).notice: Activates or deactivates an already registered organization.

submitServiceClaim(uint256,uint32,uint64.notice: Submits a pending claim for service performed by the caller's wallet.
